messages.content: 你能告訴我克里斯蒂亞諾·羅納度在英超聯賽的曼聯俱樂部的歷史進球數，然後將其與曼聯在同一聯賽中的最佳射手進行比較，最後告訴我誰是2019-2020賽季英超聯賽的最佳射手嗎？

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Tell me Cristiano Ronaldo's all-time goals for Manchester United in Premier League, compare with Manchester United's best scorer in same league, and tell who was top scorer in 2019-2020 Premier League season." We need to use the provided functions. First get Ronaldo's all-time goals for Man Utd in Premier League. Then get Manchester United's top scorer in Premier League. Then get top scorer of Premier League 2019-2020.

We have functions: player_stats_get_all_time_goals(team_name, player_name, competition optional). For Ronaldo at Man Utd. Then league_stats_get_top_scorer(league_name, season optional). For Premier League 2019-2020. For Manchester United's top scorer, we can use team_stats_get_top_scorer(team_name, competition optional). So call team_stats_get_top_scorer for Manchester United.

We need to output results. We'll call functions sequentially.
